name: GET /plans: active plans with fee and included units
source_sql: SELECT p.id AS id, p.code AS code, p.monthly_fee AS monthly_fee, p.included_units AS included_units FROM plans p WHERE p.active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.id

name: entitlement: active subscription count per tenant
source_sql: SELECT tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM subscriptions WHERE status_cd = 1 GROUP BY tenant_id

name: pkg_rating input: usage units per tenant
source_sql: SELECT tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(units) AS units FROM usage_events GROUP BY tenant_id

name: pkg_rating output: billable units per rating period
source_sql: SELECT period_id AS period_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(billable_units) AS billable FROM rating_results GROUP BY period_id

name: reference data: codes per code_type
source_sql: SELECT code_type AS code_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM codes GROUP BY code_type
